get.description: Retrieves the complete list of forwarding profile details using profile ID.

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the forwarding profile.

patch.description:
Updates the properties of the forwarding profile using profile ID.

The following fields are invalid for forwarding-profiles.

  • trustedNetworks
  • id
  • forwardingProfileActions.networkType
  • forwardingProfileZpaActions.networkType
  • unifiedTunnel.networkType
    • To unassign or remove association for array or comma-separated strings, send empty array or empty string respectively.

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the forwarding profile.

  • onNetPolicy

  • users
  • ziaPostureConfig
  • bypassApps
  • bypassCustomApps
  • appServices
  • policyToken
  • deviceType
  • policyExtension.zccFailCloseSettingsThumbPrint
  • policyExtension.locationRulesetPolicies
  • policyExtension.generateCliPasswordContract
  • policyExtension.zccFailCloseSettingsAppByPasses
  • policyExtension.zccFailCloseSettingsAppByPassNames
  • disasterRecovery.policyId
    • To unassign or remove association for array or comma-separated strings, send empty array or empty string respectively.

active.description: Indicates whether the forwarding profile is active.

name.description: Specifies the name of the forwarding profile.

conditionType.description: Specifies the condition to match the forwarding profile with traffic.

dnsServers.description: The DNS servers where your corporate network sends DNS requests.

dnsSearchDomains.description: The search domains are configured as the primary domains for the network adapter used for connecting to Zscaler.

enableLWFDriver.description: Indicates if the option to install and use the WFP-based Zscaler driver for Flow Logging, Block Domain Profile Detection, Block All Inbound Traffic, Process-Based Application Bypass, Digital Experience (ZDX) Autosense Probes, and Location Policy Override is enabled.

resolvedIpsForHostname.description: The IP addresses that the hostname resolves to.

trustedSubnets.description: The subnet of the trusted network.

trustedGateways.description: The IP address of the default gateway.

trustedDhcpServers.description: The DHCP server of the trusted network.

trustedEgressIps.description: The egress IP address of the network.

predefinedTnAll.description: Specifies all types of predefined trusted networks.

trustedNetworks.description: Specifies the list of trusted networks.

forwardingProfileActions.description: Specifies the forwarding profile actions how Zscaler Client Connector treats traffic from the users' systems for the Internet & SaaS (ZIA) service for On-Trusted Network, VPN-Trusted Network, Off-Trusted Network, or Split VPN-Trusted Network types.

forwardingProfileZpaActions.description: Specifies the forwarding profile Private Access (ZPA) actions.

enableAllDefaultAdaptersTN.description: Indicates if trusted network against all default route adapters is enabled.

enableSplitVpnTN.description: Indicates if Split VPN-trusted network is enabled.

skipTrustedCriteriaMatch.description: Indicates if Skip Trusted Criteria match for VPN Adapters is enabled.

enableUnifiedTunnel.description: Indicates if Unified Tunnel is enabled.

unifiedTunnel.description: Specifies the list of unified tunnel configurations.

createdBy.description: The user who created the forwarding profile.

editedBy.description: The user who last edited the forwarding profile.

WebPolicyContract.title: WebPolicyContract
WebPolicyContract.description: Defines the paginated response containing application profile policies, where each policy is represented by a platform-specific contract.

totalCount.description: Specifies the total number of policies in the database related to search criteria.

ForwardingProfileActionContractv2.title: ForwardingProfileActionContractv2
ForwardingProfileActionContractv2.description: Defines the forwarding profile action settings for Internet & SaaS (ZIA).

networkType.description:
Specifies the type of network.

This is a mandatory field for a PATCH request for the following arrays:

  • forwardingProfileActions
  • forwardingProfileZpaActions
  • unifiedTunnel

actionType.description: Specifies the forwarding profile actions how Zscaler Client Connector treats traffic from the  users' systems for the Internet & SaaS (ZIA) service for On-Trusted Network, VPN-Trusted Network, Off-Trusted Network, or Split VPN-Trusted Network types.

enablePacketTunnel.description: Specifies whether the packet tunnel is enabled to capture traffic specific to the Zscaler Client Connector app.

primaryTransport.description: Indicates whether primary transport for Zscaler Tunnel (Z-Tunnel) 2.0 is selected.

DTLSTimeout.description: Specifies the time, in seconds, that Zscaler Client Connector waits before falling back to another transport mechanism.

UDPTimeout.description: Specifies the UDP connection timeout in seconds.

TLSTimeout.description: Specifies the time, in seconds, that Zscaler Client Connector waits before falling back to another transport mechanism.

mtuForZadapter.description: Specifies the maximum transmission unit (MTU) for the Zscaler adapter.

blockUnreachableDomainsTraffic.description: Indicates whether the domains that are not reachable from the Public Service Edge for Internet & SaaS are dropped or bypassed.

allowTLSFallback.description: Indicates if the Allow TLS Fallback option is enabled.

tunnel2FallbackType.description:
Specifies the action in case of Z-Tunnel 2.0 failure:

  • Fallback to Z-Tunnel 1.0 and bypass non-web traffic
  • Fallback to Z-Tunnel 1.0 and block non-web traffic
  • Block all traffic

sendAllDNSToTrustedServer.description: Indicates whether Send All DNS During Fail-Close to Trusted-DNS Server is enabled.

v4FailCloseTrustedDNSServer.description: Specifies the IPv4 address that Zscaler Client Connector uses for DNS requests to an IPv4 destination.

v6FailCloseTrustedDNSServer.description: Specifies the IPv6 address that Zscaler Client Connector uses for DNS requests to an IPv6 destination.

dropIpv6Traffic.description: Indicates whether drop IPv6 traffic is enabled. When enabled, admin configured IPv6 traffic on App profile (destination inclusions) is dropped if IPv6 is not provisioned for company or Service Edge for Internet & SaaS node.

redirectWebTraffic.description: Indicates whether redirect web traffic is enabled.

dropIpv6IncludeTrafficInT2.description: Indicates whether IPv6 traffic that matches the destination inclusion is dropped.

useTunnel2ForProxiedWebTraffic.description: Specifies whether Z-Tunnel 2.0 for Proxied Web Traffic is enabled. When enabled, Zscaler Client Connector uses Z-Tunnel 2.0 protocol for tunneling web traffic received on the Zscaler Client Connector listening proxy. When disabled, Zscaler Client Connector uses the Z-Tunnel 1.0 protocol.

useTunnel2ForUnencryptedWebTraffic.description: Specifies whether Z-Tunnel 2.0 for Unencrypted Web Traffic is enabled. When enabled, Zscaler Client Connector uses Z-Tunnel 2.0 protocol for unencrypted web traffic.

pathMtuDiscovery.description: Indicates whether Zscaler Client Connector discovers the optimal path MTU for Z-Tunnel 2.0.

latencyBasedZenEnablement.description: Specifies whether the latency-based Public Service Edge option is enabled. When enabled, you can configure settings for probe interval, probe sample size, and threshold rank. By default, this option is disabled.

zenProbeInterval.description: Specifies the time interval for an IP address to connect with the server.

zenProbeSampleSize.description: Specifies the number of retries required to establish a connection before a failover.

zenThresholdLimit.description: Ranks the change in latency of the primary and secondary Public Service Edges for Internet & SaaS, Private Service Edges for Internet & SaaS, or Virtual Service Edges for Internet & SaaS.

dropIpv6TrafficInIpv6Network.description: Indicates whether Zscaler Client Connector intercepts and drops IPv6 packets coming from an IPv6-only network.

optimiseForUnstableConnections.description: Indicates whether the Optimize for Unstable Connections option is enabled.

useZIABCCOnTunnel2Failures.description: Enables use of ZIA BCC (Backup Control Channel) on Z-Tunnel 2.0 failures.

WebSystemProxyDataContract.title: WebSystemProxyDataContract
WebSystemProxyDataContract.description: Defines the system proxy configuration applied to user devices.

proxyAction.description:
Defines system proxy settings for user devices.

  • Enforce
  • Apply On-Trusted Network Type change
  • Never

enableAutoDetect.description: Indicates whether Auto Detect is enabled.

enableProxyServer.description: Indicates whether a proxy server is enabled.

bypassProxyForPrivateIP.description: Specifies the bypass proxy for private IP addresses.

performGPUpdate.description: Indicates whether Execute GPO Update is enabled.

pacDataPath.description: Specifies the registry path and name.

ForwardingProfileActionContractZpaV2.title: ForwardingProfileActionContractZpaV2

mtuForZadapter.description: Specifies the maximum transmission unit (MTU) for the Zscaler adapter.

sendTrustedNetworkResultToZpa.description: Indicates whether trusted network evaluation results are sent to ZPA, enabling split VPN adapter behavior.

latencyBasedServerEnablement.description: Indicates whether the Latency-Based Server option for machine tunnel is enabled.

lbsProbeInterval.description: Specifies the time interval (in seconds) in which an IP address connects with a server. The default is 60 seconds.

lbsProbeSampleSize.description: Specifies the number of retries required to establish a connection before a failover. The default is 5 times.

lbsThresholdLimit.description: Specifies the change in latency of the primary and secondary Public Service Edges for Private Access.

latencyBasedServerMTEnablement.description: Indicates whether the Latency-Based Server option is enabled. When enabled, you can configure settings for probe interval, probe sample size, and threshold rank. By default, this option is disabled.
